checks.reason: Generic appropriate blanks do not specify their composition, positive/procedural comparison or what each excludes.
No proposal to consult previous Methods or a validated protocol and check transfer before the validation experiment.
Detector calibration is named but has no reference standard, acceptance criterion or failed-recovery action. Time-window checks do not substitute for detector calibration.
Rate units and substrate-depletion accounting are given, but the quantitative endpoint lacks a rule for weak, saturated or missing detector readings.
No operational independent chemical-product/readout validation is given; enzyme-load and time-window checks share the same detector and cannot independently exclude its artifacts.
